Package Fitness.InstructorP.Communicate

Class NotificationSystem

java.lang.Object
Fitness.InstructorP.Communicate.NotificationSystem
public class NotificationSystem extends Object
The NotificationSystem class manages notifications for both the instructor and the clients. It stores lists of notifications for the instructor and clients, and provides methods to add or remove notifications and clients. The system allows for specific notifications to be added to either the instructor or client notification lists, as well as managing all notifications in a central list.

This class provides the following features:

  • Ability to add or remove notifications for both instructors and clients
  • Manage a list of clients associated with the instructor
  • Access to the list of all notifications and specific notification lists for the instructor and clients
Example usage: 
 Instructor instructor = new Instructor(...);
 Client client = new Client(...);
 NotificationSystem system = new NotificationSystem();
 system.addClient(client);
 Notification notification = new Notification(...);
 system.addNotification(notification);

Omar Abumazen
